feature_name: Fix: prioritize request ignore_result over task definition
description: Fix a bug where apply_async(ignore_result=False) on a task with ignore_result=True would fail to return results. Introduce get_actual_ignore_result for proper priority lookup.
functional_requirements: Implement get_actual_ignore_result with priority: Request > Task definition
Fix apply_async to respect per-call ignore_result override
Add unit tests for priority lookup in both trace and request modules
